representation.name: Specialized Door Ontology Proposer
representation.ontology: doorway, door, people, window, and author-internal mirror classes
representation.author_contract: Ultralytics inference at imgsz 640 and conf 0.10, followed by the unmodified author mirror suppression, output confidence 0.35, and door/doorway deduplication.

attribution.failure_layer: The frozen author pipeline retained no class-0 doorway or class-1 door candidate on any of the eight frames. Raw low-confidence door-like detections on two positives were removed by the author's output contract; the remaining author-final detections were people or windows.
attribution.closed: Direct current-frame RGB proposal generation with this frozen specialized door ontology and author postprocessor
attribution.forbidden_rescue: No confidence, image-size, NMS, crop, class, area, scale, postprocessor, model, or test-time-augmentation sweep on this consumed cohort.

next_step: Retain frozen SCIL and change information modality to direct relative-depth aperture topology. Do not rescue this detector.
claim_boundary: Development-only negative result on the consumed PB7 public-image cohort. It does not reject specialized door detectors generally, and establishes no portal, access, opening-state, traversability, active-view, guidance, arrival, product, user-benefit, or safety authority.
